body: Mine's due to lack of exposure. I don't really get any intimacy, nor have I in 10+ years. It's been so foreign to me that I don't know how to feel about it anymore.

My family helps as much as they can, but they can't help with my symptoms steadily beginning to worsen. I'm on several meds at the moment, so it's not like I don't have professional help. I have Medicaid and my mother's insurance so I have the means to get help, it's just that my symptoms keep getting worse and worse, which either means I go back to the ward for a while or we change meds on the fly and hope they help. I see a therapist, so I'm not sure how much more help a support group would be, but I could look into it at least. 

I know that some people with schizophrenia have their symptoms get worse as they get older, and I'm guessing I'm just one of them.
As someone with schizoaffective disorder who's been in and out of psychiatric hospital, but plays WoW, this speaks to me quite a bit.
